title: HIPAA security and encryption layers in deployment

spec.title: HIPAA security and encryption layers in deployment
spec.lead: Automated Terraform and Ansible layers enforce defense-in-depth encryption and network isolation for ePHI.
spec.notes:
The four-layer deployment automation enforces HIPAA security requirements across storage, transport, network, and identity for Contoso Health's SQL Server Always On cluster on Compute Engine. Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) protect Persistent Disks, TLS 1.2 secures endpoints on ports 1433 and 5022, VPC firewall rules isolate traffic, and Secret Manager eliminates hardcoded credentials.

Sources:
[1] Reference Architecture: High-Availability Microsoft SQL Server Databases Using Always On Availability Groups (Google Cloud, 2024) https://cloud.google.com/solutions/sql-server-always-on-availability-groups-compute-engine
[2] Deploying Microsoft SQL Server for Multi-Regional Disaster Recovery (Google Cloud, 2024) https://cloud.google.com/solutions/sql-server-multi-regional-disaster-recovery

items.title: Storage encryption with CMEK
points: Scope: all Compute Engine boot, data (pd-ssd), and log (pd-extreme) disks
Key management: Cloud KMS customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK)
Key rotation: automated periodic rotation schedule enforced in Cloud KMS
Access control: IAM least-privilege bindings for Compute Engine service agent

items.title: SQL Server TLS 1.2 transport
points: Client connections: TLS 1.2 enforced on SQL Server database engine listeners
Replica traffic: certificate-authenticated encryption on mirroring endpoint port 5022
Cipher suites: legacy SSL and TLS 1.0/1.1 protocols disabled via OS registry
Certificate lifecycle: internal PKI certificates deployed across all three cluster nodes

items.title: VPC firewall port restriction
points: Client SQL access: TCP port 1433 restricted to Tier-1 clinical app subnets
Always On replication: TCP port 5022 limited to the three SQL Server VM IPs
WSFC and health probes: UDP/TCP cluster ports and ILB probe port isolated by tag
Administration: zero public IPs on VMs; RDP access only via IAP TCP forwarding

items.title: Secret Manager credential hygiene
points: Storage: SQL Server service account and AD join passwords in Secret Manager
Deployment retrieval: Ansible fetches secrets at runtime with zero cleartext in Git
Identity: dedicated least-privilege IAM service accounts per Compute Engine node
Audit trail: Cloud Audit Logs enabled for all Secret Manager and KMS reads
